title: AdGuard Top Blocked Client Drift
app: Kubernetes homelab clusters, Proxmox, Vaultwarden, Paperless-ngx, Immich, AdGuard Home, Docker, TrueNAS, and NUT metrics via APIs, logs, Telegraf, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=adguard:query blocked="true"
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as blocked_queries by client _time
| eventstats avg(blocked_queries) as baseline_blocked_queries by client
| where baseline_blocked_queries>0 AND blocked_queries>baseline_blocked_queries*1.5
| sort - blocked_queries
description: Uses AdGuard blocked-query logs telemetry to monitor weekly growth in blocked requests from each client in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for devices that suddenly started talking to noisier endpoints, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest AdGuard blocked-query logs data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It produces weekly growth in blocked requests from each client so you can spot devices that suddenly started talking to noisier endpoints before it becomes annoying.
